name: name-constraints-minimum-nonzero-form-absent-valid
description: The CA carries a critical dNSName permittedSubtree with minimum set to 1, but the leaf has no dNSName. RFC 5280 requires applications to process or reject non-zero minimum when that name form appears in a subsequent certificate; when the constrained name form is absent, the restriction has nothing to apply to and the chain is acceptable.
notes: This is the absent-name-form counterpart to name-constraints-minimum-nonzero-invalid. It catches validators that reject any critical minimum field while parsing the CA, instead of deferring the process-or-reject requirement to certificates that actually contain the constrained name form.
